svg.data-weight-note: 125 lb (57 kg) with the backplane only, 159 lb (72 kg) as the standard system ships, 215 lb (98 kg) fully loaded (guide Table 7); 213 to 215 lb (97 to 98 kg) with other line cards or supplies
svg.data-width-note: 17.3 in (43.9 cm) body; 19 in (48.3 cm) with the front-mounting brackets (guide Table 7)
svg.data-depth-note: 15.5 in (39.3 cm) (guide Table 7 and the datasheet)
svg.data-fabric-bandwidth: 64 Gbps full duplex per line card slot with one SRE module, 128 Gbps with two (guide); 720 Gbps of switching capacity per SRE module (datasheet)
svg.data-port-density: up to 384 10/100/1000BASE-T ports with two SRE modules and eight line cards, up to 432 with one SRE module and nine line cards (guide, datasheet)
svg.data-line-cards: EX6200-48T, EX6200-48P and EX6200-48F; not modelled (see gaps)
svg.data-base-power-budget-note: the maximum draw of the fan tray (300 W) and two SRE modules (100 W each); the same with one (guide, Calculating the Chassis Base Power Budget)
svg.data-psu-types: 2500 W AC, 5000 W AC or 2100 W DC; do not mix types, wattages or low-line and high-line feeds in one chassis
svg.data-redundancy-note: up to four supplies; N+1 is the default and N+N (2+2) can be configured; a shipping order includes one supply
svg.data-airflow-note: front to back; intake at the front right, exhaust at the rear left; each supply has its own fan
svg.data-thermal-output-note: 3.41 BTU/hr per watt of maximum system power (guide, Table 35)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) (guide Table 42); 0 to 45 C in the 2011 datasheet
svg.data-humidity: 10 to 85 percent noncondensing (guide Table 42); 5 to 90 percent in the 2011 datasheet
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 10,000 ft (3048 m) (guide Table 42)
svg.data-cpu: 1.2 GHz dual-core on each SRE module (datasheet)
svg.data-memory: 2 GB DRAM and 2 GB flash on each SRE module (datasheet)
svg.data-redundancy: one or two SRE modules with graceful Routing Engine switchover; the fan tray, supplies and SRE modules are field-replaceable
svg.data-sre-slots: slots 4 and 5 take an SRE module or a line card; at least one SRE module is required; with one, the guide recommends slot 4
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000BASE-T and one Gigabit Ethernet SFP management port on each SRE module (one works at a time)
svg.data-console: RJ-45 serial console on each SRE module
svg.data-usb: one USB port on each SRE module
svg.data-lcd: two-line, 16-character LCD with Menu and Enter buttons on each SRE module
svg.data-acoustic: 52 dBA with AC supplies, 54 dBA with DC supplies, at 27 C, ISO 7779 (datasheet, bystander position at the front)
svg.data-seismic: Complies with Zone 4 earthquake requirements as per GR-63, Issue 4 (guide Table 42)
svg.data-nebs: GR-63-Core, GR-1089-Core and SR-3580 NEBS Criteria Levels (Level 3) are listed under the customer-specific requirements of the 2011 datasheet, which marks the NEBS environmental standard in its feature table "Roadmap"
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Class A, EN 55022 Class A, VCCI Class A, CISPR 22 Class A, AS/NZS CISPR 22 Class A (datasheet)

g.data-redundancy-note: n+1 by default and n+n (2+2) by configuration (guide, Understanding EX6210 Switch Component and Functionality Redundancy); a shipping order has one supply
g.data-description: the four power supply slots PSU 0 to PSU 3 at the foot of the front (guide Table 11 and Figure 5)

g.data-description: the wrist-strap ESD points, one at the front top right and one at the rear lower left (guide Figures 1 and 2)
